report.title: Option to automatically enter Focus Mode when starting to edit a memo
report.body:
### Check before submitting

- [x] I searched existing issues and did not find a duplicate

### What problem would this solve?

I prefer writing in Focus Mode most of the time. Currently, every time I create a new memo or edit an existing one, I have to manually enable Focus Mode. This becomes repetitive and interrupts the writing flow.

### What would you like to happen?

Add a user preference (e.g. in Settings) that allows Focus Mode to be automatically enabled when entering the editor (both for new memos and when editing existing ones). Users should still be able to exit Focus Mode normally.

### Additional context

_No response_

plan.reported_actual: Focus Mode must be enabled manually each time a memo is created or edited; there is no preference to enable it automatically.
missing: This is a feature request, not a bug; there is no defective behavior to reproduce
Where exactly the preference should live in Settings and what it should be called
plan.summary: Feature request: setting to auto-enable Focus Mode when editing memos

verdict.headline: This does not look like something visible in a desktop browser UI.
